verses.text: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.
I will praise the LORD all my life. I will sing praises to my God as long as I live.
Do not put your trust in rulers, in mere humans who cannot save you.
When their breath leaves them, they go back to the ground. On that very day all their plans come to nothing.
Happy are those whose helper is the God of Jacob, whose hope is in the LORD their God.
He made heaven and earth, the sea, and everything in them. He stays faithful forever.
He gives justice to those who are crushed and food to those who are hungry. The LORD sets prisoners free.
The LORD opens the eyes of blind people. The LORD lifts up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves good people.
The LORD watches over foreigners. He takes care of children with no father and widows, but he ruins the plans of the wicked.
The LORD will rule forever. Your God, Zion, will rule for all generations. Praise the LORD!
